notes.md: - **All England Open 2026 – women's singles:** **Wang Zhiyi** (China) beat world No. 1 **An Se-young** (South Korea) **21–15, 21–19** in the final (8 March 2026) – her first All England title; the first Chinese women's singles champion there since **Chen Yufei (2019)**.

- **ISSF World Cup Final 2025 (Doha, Qatar, December 2025):** India won **6 medals (2 gold, 3 silver, 1 bronze)** – its best-ever haul at the event – and finished **2nd** behind China. Golds: **Simranpreet Kaur Brar** (women's **25 m pistol**) and **Suruchi Singh** (women's **10 m air pistol**).
- **LA 2028 cricket venue:** announced on **15 April 2025** – a temporary stadium at the **Fairgrounds (Fairplex), Pomona**, Southern California; **six-team T20** events for both men and women.
- **PKL Season 12 final (31 October 2025, Thyagaraj Indoor Stadium, New Delhi):** **Dabang Delhi K.C.** beat **Puneri Paltan 31–28**; Delhi's first title had come in **Season 8**.
